from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single cash balance metric extracted from a 10-Q filing."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document registrant field")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the cash line item as written in the document (e.g., 'Cash, Beginning of Period')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit the amount represents (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date or period the balance refers to (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim text line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_entries: list[CashBalanceEntry]
